gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests that two X5455_ExtendedTimestamp instances with differing create times are not considered equal, even when their flags bytes share the same CREATE_TIME_BI
ADDED i2: Set up first entry: flags byte -76 (0xB4) whose lower 3 bits = 4 (CREATE_TIME_BIT), but no timestamp values are stored.
ADDED i3: Set up second entry: assign DD_SIG as the create time, which also sets CREATE_TIME_BIT in the flags and marks isBit2_createTimePresent() as true.
ADDED i4: The two entries differ in their createTime field (null vs DD_SIG), so equals() must return false.
